steps.visual_purpose: Show the approved instance IDs and target limit alongside their environment-variable configuration values, both rejection results, and supplied operation evidence confirming no resource-changing call occurred.

Show a completed CREATE change set with the proposed EC2 addition and a separate execution action, alongside a supplied update change set displaying the EC2 modification and replacement indicator so unintended replacement is visible before authorization.

Show the supplied statement's action scope alongside three request contexts: aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent true, false, and absent. For a covered action with an existing Allow, make visible that this Deny does not match the true case but matches both the false and absent cases; distinguish those results from requests outside the statement's action scope.

Make the caller-to-role-to-assumed-session relationship visible, separating caller-side sts:AssumeRole permission, the role trust policy's principal and condition checks, and the role permissions policy governing the session's work.

Make the supplied MFA status, root-use evidence, and root access-key evidence visible alongside separate checklist findings, including whether each simulated root key remains needed and its removal status.

Make the selected Region, event-history attribute filter and time interval visible alongside candidate events and the matching event's eventTime, eventName, userIdentity and requestParameters or resources.

Show the Workload cost-allocation tag as active and the selected Cost Explorer period grouped by Workload, with the orders category and unallocated spend visible alongside supplied resource-tag evidence.

Show the supplied collector's application file path, destination group and stream alongside the destination stream containing the known orders JSON event with its request ID, outcome and timestamp preserved.

Make the sandbox service's configuration state, supplied rollback files, pre-activation check result, activation result, service status and effective-setting result visible, including the restored and reactivated state after failure.

Make progressive workload replacement, separate old and new environments with a traffic switch, and limited initial traffic exposure visibly distinct. Show each supplied proposal's parallel-capacity needs and route back to the known-good version alongside the scenario requirements.
Make the expected CloudWatch metric and its InstanceId dimension visible alongside the approved sandbox host identity so that the learner can verify both the signal and its source.

Show successive supplied evaluation windows with period samples, threshold comparisons, breach counts, configured evaluation counts, missing-data policy, prior state and resulting state. Distinguish missing samples from real zero values and include complete-sample and all-missing cases.
